create_monolingual_dataset: create a MonolingualDataset instance wrapping raw data with source and target vocabularies for language modeling
collate_samples: collate a list of sample dicts into a padded mini-batch tensor for model input
filter_target_vocab: filter target tokens to replace out-of-vocabulary indices with the target vocab unknown token
add_bos_token: add a beginning-of-sequence token to source and target tensors for multilingual language model inputs
get_ordered_indices: get an ordered list of dataset indices sorted by size with optional shuffling for batching
